title: PROVERBS 16:9
THE GUIDED PATH
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step
stock_queries: serene alpine river winding through pine trees
quiet mountain lake at dawn reflection
misty forest path under tall trees
calm mountain ridge in soft golden light
tranquil valley landscape with gentle morning fog

scenes.a: If you are holding back an unfinished plan tonight because you fear your own misstep, listen.
The word of God reminds us in Proverbs 16:9:
A man's heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.
Father, we confess that our own understanding is so often limited by what we can see right now.
We lay our personal agendas down before Your throne and ask You to order every future step we take.
Close every door that leads away from Your peace, and give us the quiet grace to walk only where You lead.
